property_summary: Only an admin can create a new EmergencyOracle, so calling newEmergencyOracle with a non-admin sender must revert.
Only an admin can successfully create a new EmergencyOracle through C.

After calling newEmergencyOracle with any description, the returned newOracle address should correspond to an EmergencyOracle whose owner() equals msg.sender; the bug version uses address(0) as owner, so owner() will be address(0) instead of the caller.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the newly created EmergencyOracle's owner() must equal the msg.sender of that call; the bug sets owner to address(0), breaking equality.
After any call to newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the created EmergencyOracle must equal the caller; the bug sets owner to address(0), making it unequal to the caller.

After any call to newEmergencyOracle, the NewEmergencyOracle event's owner parameter must equal the caller; the bug uses address(0) as the oracle owner, so the event's owner parameter (which is msg.sender) differs from the actual owner of the created oracle.
